_comment: Every package in package.json must be listed here. Adding a package means adding it here first, in its own commit, with evidence it exists and is maintained (npm view <name> version time.modified). Versions below were checked against the npm registry on the date shown.

typescript.purpose: Type checking. Strict mode is what catches invented APIs.

dompurify.purpose: Sanitise rendered notes before they go into a shared file.
